name: UltimateBeneficialOwner
description: Records the identity and verification status of each natural person identified as a beneficial owner of a BusinessCustomer under MLR 2017 Regulation 5 — natural persons with >25% direct or indirect ownership of shares, voting rights, or right to appoint/remove majority of directors. Where no natural person meets the threshold, the senior managing official(s) are recorded as UBO of last resort (MLR 2017 Regulation 5(4)). Each UBO record links to the SVC-050 IdentityVerification record once identity is verified. This entity is the bank's audit trail for UBO identification compliance under MLR 2017 Regulation 40.

fields.name: first_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. 1–100 characters. Sourced from Companies House PSC data initially; updated from identity verification if discrepancy.
fields.transparency_note: Personal data of a third party (not the primary applicant). Collected under MLR 2017 legal obligation (UK GDPR Article 6(1)(c)). Privacy notice sent via verification invitation.

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.validation_rule: Required once identity verification is complete. ISO 8601. CDD matching field for PEP/sanctions screening.

fields.name: nationality
fields.validation_rule: Required once identity verification is complete. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. At least one required.

fields.name: ownership_percentage
fields.validation_rule: Required. 0.01–100.00, max 2 dp. Must be > 25.00 for MLR 2017 threshold unless ubo_type = senior_managing_official.

fields.name: control_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum values: shares | voting_rights | appointment_removal_right | senior_managing_official. MLR 2017 Regulation 5(1) control categories. Array — UBO may have multiple control types.

fields.name: companies_house_psc_notified_date
fields.validation_rule: Optional. ISO 8601. Date registered on PSC register. Null for senior_managing_official UBOs of last resort.

fields.name: verification_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | invited | in_progress | verified | failed | waived. 'waived' requires MLRO approval.

fields.name: verification_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when verification_status = verified. FK → IdentityVerification.verification_id (owned by SVC-050).

fields.name: cdd_screening_result
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Populated by SVC-014 after BPH-005. Object: pep_status (enum: clear | match | pending_review), sanctions_status (enum: clear | blocked | pending_review), adverse_media_status (enum: clear | flagged | pending_review), screened_at (timestamp). Access restricted to SVC-014 and PER-052 (MLRO).
fields.transparency_note: Screening results are AML-sensitive. Never surfaced to PER-002. Tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A) applies.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when UBO entity created from Companies House PSC data at BPH-003.

design_decisions.decision: cdd_screening_result is stored on UltimateBeneficialOwner (owned by SVC-005), not as a separate entity owned by SVC-014.
design_decisions.rationale: The individual-level screening result for a UBO is logically part of the UBO record. Company-level CDD assessment is held in BusinessKycAssessment (SVC-014). MLRO audit trail for individual UBO screening is satisfied by WORM event logging.

design_decisions.decision: UltimateBeneficialOwner does not reference ENT-001 (Customer) even where the UBO is also a retail customer.
design_decisions.rationale: Retail and commercial are separate capability domains. FK from ENT-B003 to ENT-001 would couple CAP-002 to CAP-001. Identity correlation is performed by a separate identity resolution service at query time.
